release_notes: Fixes a bug in the `--mode set-version` command that caused an error when the version was already set in RELEASE_NOTES.json
Add `--mode set-version` and bump version in pyproject.toml
Initial alpha release of ReleaseSaga, a standalone Python CLI for release automation with Saga-style rollback.
Adds a configurable release pipeline that reads target-project metadata from pyproject.toml and supports CLI overrides for release behavior.
Ships built-in release steps for AWS S3 uploads, git tag creation, GitHub release creation, and PyPI publishing with preflight checks before execution.
Implements reverse-order rollback, including rollback of the failing step first and best-effort cleanup for earlier completed steps.
Documents how to extend the pipeline with custom ReleaseStep implementations for project-specific release actions.
